QuestInfo.name: Knowledge about Dragons 3
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1032001##k starts talking to you. Has the #t4032467# been verified?
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1032001#'s friend Tatamo, it's certain that #p1013000# is an Onyx Dragon. He asks that you come to #m240000000# if you want more details. Go to #b#m240000000#.#k.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You met Tatamo in #m240000000#. He was very happy to see #p1013000# and told you about Onyx Dragons and how they became extinct...

0.0: I finally heard back from Tatamo! He says the owner of the scale is definitely an Onyx Dragon! Since he's spent much of his life with Dragons and has raised a number of Baby Dragons, he can't be wrong.
0.1: Tatamo is very curious as to how you were able to find the scale of an Onyx Dragon. Honestly, I'm extremely curious myself, but I won't ask since you seem to want to keep it a secret.
0.2: Tatamo wants you to come to #m240000000# and tell him more about Onyx Dragons. In return, he'll share what he knows about Onyx Dragons. Why don't you head to #b#m240000000##k now? I'll #b#eteleport you to #m240000000# right away.#k#n
0.3: Before you go, you must know that #m240000000# is very dangerous. #rDo not, I repeat, do NOT#k go to the field unless you are absolutely sure you can take on those high level monsters. Safety first!

no.0: Hm, I guess you're not that curious.

npc.0: Have you not gone to Leafre yet? Tatamo is desperately waiting for the Onyx Dragon... I mean, you. He's desperately waiting for you.
